feature: Daily LLM spend cap (owner decision 2026-10-03; FILM-1910, FILM-1902): server-mode web runs only, never MCP or renders

mutations.name: CAP1 the cap is never enforced
CAP2 spend equal to the cap is let through
CAP3 calls of unknown cost refuse on their own
mutations.pattern: never refuses on calls of unknown cost alone

mutations.name: CAP4 a spend read that fails refuses the run
CAP5 the refusal hides calls of unknown cost
mutations.pattern: says how many calls have no known cost

mutations.name: CAP6 today is not the UTC day
CAP7 an external run is capped too
mutations.pattern: external run with spend over the cap

mutations.name: CAP8 a render goes through the server-run checks
CAP9 the page gets no words for the cap refusal
CAP10 the team's cap is not read
CAP-DB1 a cap of zero or less is accepted
CAP-DB2 a signed-in user may call the spend read
mutations.sql: grant execute on function public.llm_spend_since(uuid, timestamptz) to authenticated;

mutations.name: CAP-DB3 usage of external runs is summed
mutations.sql: create or replace function public.llm_spend_since(p_account_id uuid, p_since timestamptz) returns table (spent_usd numeric, priced_calls integer, unpriced_calls integer) language sql stable security invoker set search_path = '' as $f$ select sum(u.total_cost), count(u.total_cost)::integer, (count(*) - count(u.total_cost))::integer from public.llm_usage_analytics u join public.generation_runs r on r.id = u.run_id where u.account_id = p_account_id and u.created_at >= p_since; $f$;

mutations.name: CAP-DB4 an unpriced call is summed as 0
mutations.sql: create or replace function public.llm_spend_since(p_account_id uuid, p_since timestamptz) returns table (spent_usd numeric, priced_calls integer, unpriced_calls integer) language sql stable security invoker set search_path = '' as $f$ select coalesce(sum(u.total_cost), 0), count(*)::integer, 0 from public.llm_usage_analytics u join public.generation_runs r on r.id = u.run_id and r.mode = 'server' where u.account_id = p_account_id and u.created_at >= p_since; $f$;
